scope.contract: Every control discovered by the checker is registered exactly once with an owner, rationale, revisit condition, and current classification. scientific-choice entries remain explicit because they select a different mathematical approximation or an explicitly declared source/target initialization policy; execution-only choices may be promoted only through evidence-bound guards. Registration is policy bookkeeping only and never constitutes performance or numerical promotion.

entries.rationale: Explicit experimental masks pack selected FP64 canonical buckets and retain the same exact compensated Direct consumer for every remaining bucket. Screened sources share the incumbent frozen Schwarz rows and compact counts. Unset controls preserve complete residency, method-specific ceilings and existing cold eligibility. Resource, scientific capability and lifetime refusals remain bounded; the public KS planner still reserves no optional quartic storage. The existing resource-constrained RHF evidence is not PBE0 or global-default evidence.
entries.revisit_condition: Qualify a resource- and reuse-conditioned selector against natural master defaults with independent complete Cold/Warm/Moved E+F gates, repeated endpoint/work counts, full-cache crossovers and allocation cliffs. Do not hard-code a molecule or replace profitable full residency with a partial mask merely because a constrained RHF subset improved.

entries.rationale: Unset admits fixed FP64 J/K/range-K anchors at 192 or more AOs for relaxed application-budget Fast WB97M-V restricted exact-Direct cold nonlocal outer solves, without a fixed upper AO limit. Shared budget-Fock admission also has no fixed AO or atom-count ceiling; native dimensions, actual resources and all other scientific conditions remain checked. Explicit 1 opts in smaller scientifically eligible owners; 0 disables. Provisional operators act on total current-minus-anchor density; full targets refresh strict anchors and nonlinear XC/VV10 retain total density. Unsupported domains, warm solves and optional device-allocation failure preserve the incumbent path. Five FP64 matrices and one scalar are charged, then retired at a pressured force handoff without revoking D/W/XC or the final token; later solves use ordinary Fast. Numerical acceptance thresholds are unchanged. Historical measurements do not qualify every newly admitted larger shape.
entries.revisit_condition: Require profitable complete-endpoint evidence before lowering the 192-AO automatic floor: retained water-12 observations are adverse. Removing count ceilings is not a new large-size accuracy or speed qualification. Record independent large-system energy/force gates and actual work/resource failures separately. Qualify other models, precision, spin, DF, warm, chunk or public resource-ledger anchor domains independently; preserve strict full-target audits, explicit rollback and force-phase optional-memory fallback.

entries.rationale: Unset or 1 permits exact density-generating AO-factor reuse only for strict-FP64 restricted DF seeds with the existing complete projection certificate and matching owner, source, device, stream, shape, rank, epoch and generation. U is rebuilt through the shared provider. Explicit 0, invalid values and ineligible seeds retain dense first K; no numeric storage or scientific gate is added or relaxed.
entries.revisit_condition: Qualify new precision, spin, metric, provider-capacity or lifetime domains independently. Preserve explicit rollback, exact density reconstruction and bounded fallbacks; retained 96-atom wins are not universal timing claims.

entries.rationale: Explicit opt-in adds an independent dense K/full-Fock comparison at the actual first occupied cold or warm build. Its temporary host matrices, transfers, extra contractions and profiler fences are diagnostic work excluded from clean endpoint timing; the audit stays off by default.
entries.revisit_condition: Keep numerical matrix validation separate from production replay and clean performance evidence; do not promote the diagnostic overhead as part of the execution policy.

entries.rationale: Automatic screened SPD strict range sources serve restricted VV10 cold initialization with at least 65536 points, the existing reuse threshold and a 16 GiB optional ceiling. The independent Direct range correction may accompany a Direct or fitted full-range primary. Both providers host inventory and actual device headroom remain charged; omitted buckets stream exactly. Warm calls never construct a quartic source. Explicit zero, unsupported precision and public-ledger fallbacks remain. Fitted-default candidate endpoint qualification is tracked separately from earlier explicit-cache pilots.
entries.revisit_condition: Require source-matched complete cold/warm/moved endpoints, independent energy/force gates and capacity/lifetime evidence for any broader automatic domain; retain failed populations and do not relabel explicit-cache pilots as default evidence.

entries.rationale: An admitted audited radial lease survives same-geometry warm replay by default only while range, bucket and capacity selections match. Independent source and incumbent energy baselines preserve physical convergence after policy changes and force-memory eviction. Every call still executes the physical Fock and complete force work; explicit zero retires the source.
entries.revisit_condition: Keep complete endpoint, no-new-warm-source, policy-invalidation and failure-cleanup gates; this does not expand radial source admission or resolve the unqualified large-capacity domain.

entries.rationale: Unset/auto selects bounded full-range values for admitted cold exact FP64 Direct RKS/UKS, including Coulomb-only and compatible nonlocal compositions. Explicit 0 restores the incumbent schedule. Positive-mask through-d candidates retain a 16-GiB value ceiling; generic f-shell auto retains 8 GiB and forced selection remains capped at 16 GiB. Complete consumer/source admission and the prepared Schwarz predicate remain mandatory. Warm/external-seeded auto skips cloning and sorting. A successful source charges one incumbent fixed-density warm-energy handoff by bypassing the retained source; the returned physical state and convergence gates remain unchanged. Completed actions are audited and captured borrowers retired before values remain with the converged owner for post-SCF value consumers. Ordinary values never replace derivative integrals, and restart/failure/destruction retires the source. Public ledgers retain their incumbent path because no quartic allowance is reserved. RSH, DF, mixed and incremental routes are excluded. Independent RKS/UKS endpoints, signed-spin J/K, lifetime and compiled resource/policy gates qualify this boundary; registration alone is not a promotion or profitability prediction.
entries.revisit_condition: Reserve optional quartic storage in the complete public planner and renew source-matched cold/warm/seeded/budget-refusal E+F evidence with independent energy/force gates and semantic work counts before widening the current source domain further. Broaden resource-cliff, quickly converged cold, hardware and crossover coverage; retain explicit 0 rollback and distinguish value from derivative capabilities.

entries.rationale: Unset/auto retains the existing fresh single restricted unscreened physical-reference domain: uncovered generic f-shell Fock work, at least 64 public/128 Cartesian AOs, iteration limit at least eight, 8-GiB value ceiling. Ordinary restricted FP64 cold solves additionally admit through-d screened domains with 64 or more public AOs and at most 128 Cartesian AOs, iteration limit at least eight and a 512-MiB value ceiling. These require a fresh single-system bucket, internal guess and no active public resource ledger. Other ordinary sizes refuse before provider cloning/sorting. Complete numeric admission and free-device reserve retain exact fallback. Phase graphs retire before values; warm/reused buckets retain ordinary graphs. Final derivative metadata is explicitly produced from the selected final density. Explicit 0 restores the streamed schedule and 1 remains subject to scientific/resource gates. The static domain guard is not a universal profitability model.
entries.revisit_condition: Broaden either cold/domain heuristic only with source-matched complete cold/warm/moved E+F comparisons and independent gates, including quickly converged fresh seeds, larger sizes and constrained resources. Forced larger ordinary domains currently regress despite fitting memory. Preserve final physical Fock/census audits, derivative density identity, compensated FP64 arithmetic and bounded lifetime; never pool forced exploratory populations with actual default-auto qualification.

entries.rationale: The native DF-CCSD(T) owner may preconverge a detached density with a separately bundled H/C JK-fit basis for neutral spherical through-f cold references. Admission excludes cache-eligible exact references, requires a conservative dense Cartesian/fitting sweep-volume amortization screen, charges actual preparation metadata/matrices under the finite cap, and requires the shared source-backed dense/packed planner to retain full factors with metadata and DIIS reservations; there is no fixed AO interval. Streamed proposals are skipped because bounded memory does not imply profitable work. The volume screen is a heuristic, not a universal measured crossover or actual integral census. The accepted RHF reference, Hamiltonian and complete analytic response remain unscreened FP64 Direct. Preliminary work is finite and included in reference/endpoint timing; unsupported topology, tight budgets and refused guesses retain Direct. Explicit or warm density seeds take precedence.
entries.revisit_condition: Expand the topology/resource domain only with independent reference/force gates and paired complete endpoint evidence, including a larger planner case. Never interpret this policy as promotion of a fitted accepted reference or DF-HF gradients.

entries.rationale: The exact incremental Direct-J/K implementation (#990/#1579) remains opt-in. The reduced #1598 historical capsule retains one matched 384-AO RHF baseline/incremental round: incremental prepared-plan cold execution (setup excluded, cold arrays absent) is about 41% slower and warm E/F is 103% slower; all three retained warm independent-reference and matched-arm numerical pairs pass. Seven additional final outcomes record unsuccessful retried 192/768-AO points, but missing per-attempt diagnostics do not establish their failure cause or baseline success. Other successful campaign records are not retained here; the earlier reported 96-AO cold gain rules out a blanket claim that every endpoint loses. UHF/moved populations were incomplete and KS acceptance was not established. Invalid retained quartet work counters cannot certify a bounded-resource guard. This is scoped historical negative evidence, not a complete default-promotion qualification. The route remains available to the narrower KS/PBE0 owner #2053.
entries.revisit_condition: Reopen promotion only after provider-owned bounded-streaming admitted/rejected work accounting exists and a candidate guard domain shows matched complete-endpoint wins across cold, warm and moved-geometry RHF/UHF populations with unchanged numerical gates, repeated interleaved timing, exact source/library/device identity, and compile/artifact reuse cost charged to admission; or if a materially different late-SCF work distribution reopens the economics.

entries.rationale: Guarded auto-on cold-only incremental J/K for default-grid all-electron restricted FP64 exact Direct global hybrids (64-768 public AOs, 2-96 atoms, orbital shells through d), only without a resource ledger. Native cold guess provenance admits the public Huckel seed. Source-matched unset/off RTX 5090 qualification covers 12/48/96-atom PBE0 plus B3LYP/M06-2X lifecycle cases, with independent complete E/F gates and no meaningful frozen-warm regression. The original two-full-Fock final acceptance and warm single-Fock path remain. Explicit 0/off opts out; explicit on preserves the broader experimental selector. HF, DF, UKS, Fast, custom/strict/grid, imported/moved seed, unsupported angular/source and ledger-bound owners retain their existing route; Fast/DF compatibility is qualified without incremental acceleration.
entries.revisit_condition: Requalify independent complete E/F, actual Fock work and cold/warm latency when changing admission, initial-guess provenance, screening, closure or storage ownership. Fast requires an audited precision-epoch/strict-anchor composition; DF requires its own signed-delta producer and measured endpoint benefit. Sampled stock-grid water qualification does not establish quadrature convergence, universal performance, or public-resource-plan promotion.

entries.rationale: The incremental XC anchor/update route is an experimental controller and is not a public/default execution policy.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit after complete-solve numerical and endpoint qualification demonstrates a profitable guarded domain without weakening final-state or force checks.

entries.rationale: The default-promotion decision is to retain strict FP64 and require explicit precision=auto. Source-bound DFT warmup evidence includes five alternating small-water cold/warm/changed E+force pairs that lose to FP64 and four repaired larger cold single-pair screens with FP64/AUTO ratios 0.6385, 0.7430, 0.7159 and 0.8156. Returned repaired endpoints meet their recorded numerical gates and execute mixed J, but neither those screens nor historical HF evidence qualify a general default. Large screens are not repeated promotion trials and their distinct cold guesses prevent attributing every iteration difference to arithmetic. This is a scoped negative default decision, not DFT-MP-v1 completion, a claim about every mixed workload, or a new measurement on current master.
entries.revisit_condition: The narrower precision owners may propose a source-identified guard only after repeatable complete cold/warm/moved endpoint benefit, observed mixed and strict work, all refinement/retry costs and unchanged independent scientific gates. #1189 still requires its frozen per-method 1.20x product result; this negative policy decision does not close or weaken that target.

entries.rationale: The environment threshold is a legacy diagnostic/qualification override. Product policy is the explicit public precision request, not an environment-variable default.
entries.revisit_condition: Retire the override after all retained qualification and audit workflows use the public precision policy and no historical reproduction depends on it.

entries.rationale: These controls force reference, tracing, validation, profiling, or qualification behavior. They are audit surfaces rather than candidates for automatic product policy.

entries.revisit_condition: Retire the override after forced-path endpoint qualification no longer needs it; changes to automatic admission still require matched endpoint evidence.

entries.revisit_condition: Independent generated value/xyz-jet and full/LR molecular oracles, sanitizer, frozen policy/fallback checks, actual work and same-binary complete cold/warm/displaced/larger endpoint evidence before any promotion.

entries.revisit_condition: The Direct scheduling owner #597 retains these shell-class experiments. Reclassify each selector only when complete endpoint evidence admits a guarded default or establishes a durable negative decision; preserve explicit comparison controls and all existing fallbacks.

Prepared KS Hcore now honors the existing cooperative default with implicit triangular AO addressing after a new five-pair 48/96-atom warm/moved-warm qualification; overlap-only Pulay and explicit noncooperative schedules retain component lanes. Historical failed promotion populations remain retained.

entries.rationale: Work-qualified whole-shell Coulomb-norm screening defaults to a 1e-10 absolute force-component budget on probed CUDA targets with sufficient work. The original sm_120 96-atom warm endpoint improves 27.4%; that performance evidence does not claim the same speedup elsewhere. Independent numerical, geometry, batch and constrained-panel checks pass; unprobed, small and capacity-limited consumers retain strict evaluation. The earlier SSS primitive screen remains independently off.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit numerical bounds if the mathematical screen changes and benchmark representative workloads before claiming speedups on new devices. Preserve explicit off, unchanged tile selection and strict optional-allocation fallback; forward B storage is unchanged.

entries.rationale: Final policy: retain explicit bounded tuning and caller-selected schedules. Ordinary plan_cuda uses BASELINE_SCHEDULE and does not load historical tuning winners. Qualified tuning returns a concrete plan/artifact and complete evidence for its exact workload, source and device; that is not a global automatic dispatcher. Positive retained layout/schedule results remain valid on their original identities. Views, fusion, recomputation, donation and layout selection are not enabled globally; direct GEMM and existing compiler legality transformations retain their separately qualified defaults.
entries.revisit_condition: Reopen automatic winner loading only for a complete production consumer that binds source/device/workload/artifact identity, charges preparation and cache costs, and deterministically retains the baseline on every miss or stale receipt. Keep explicit tuning available independently.

entries.rationale: Both streaming schedules remain explicit memory-oriented alternatives. Retained RTX 5090 and H100 complete-endpoint evidence shows substantial runtime regressions against the deterministic baseline despite smaller arenas; the generated-reduction variant is still about 10.4x and 27.0x slower on the retained H100 workloads. Neither schedule belongs in default search.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider only after a new bounded cooperative/persistent lowering shares producer work and passes independent numerical, resource, and complete-endpoint gates on an identified workload domain; lower memory or launch counts alone do not justify promotion.

entries.rationale: Shared producer reuse remains explicitly selected and defaults off. Coordinate, precision, independence, readiness, storage and bounded expansion/resource proofs admit only legal groups; other groups retain unfused execution. Source-bound H200 numerical/replay/alias/derivative evidence covers the retained synthetic (T) domain, but the 8x16 full lifecycle is about 9.6% slower than default. Prior instrumented work counters are separate artifacts, and full SCF/CCSD, molecular forces and parent production acceptance remain unqualified.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider promotion only after independent source/device/workload-bound numerical and resource qualification plus significant interleaved complete production endpoint evidence. Preserve unfused fallback, exact execution-partition identity and the default-off policy on every unsupported or stale context; lower launch/work counts alone are insufficient.

entries.rationale: TensorSchedule defaults direct_gemm to true, and ordinary plan_cuda uses that BASELINE_SCHEDULE. Existing layout and GEMM legality checks select direct execution when supported; direct_gemm=false retains the explicit packed comparison path.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit when direct-GEMM legality, layout eligibility, or baseline policy changes; preserve the explicit packed opt-out and do not treat the already-default dimension as an unqualified opt-in.

entries.rationale: Final policy: PreparedCuda keeps ordinary execution as the default; execution_mode=cuda-graph remains explicit. Historical TensorIR replay gains qualify those workloads but do not establish automatic capture admission for arbitrary prepared consumers. In particular, a global ResourcePlan has no qualified graph retained-storage candidate and therefore uses ordinary fallback. Explicit graph invalidation, identity checks, failure fallback and existing method-owned HF graphs remain unchanged; this decision concerns TensorIR automatic promotion only.
entries.revisit_condition: Reopen automatic capture only with a bounded graph-storage candidate in the complete resource owner, identity-safe invalidation, repeated complete-endpoint benefit including capture, and ordinary fallback on resource/capture/identity failure.

entries.rationale: Ordinary native KS requests up to 32 independent original XC tiles within an additional allowance of 32 MiB times the larger AO/density-product jet count (32 MiB when both are one, 128 MiB when either is four). GGA AO panels therefore retain capacity even with one density-product jet. Explicit byte caps are exact, and automatic allocation rejection retries the original 32-MiB allowance. Compiler residency admission and the shared numeric resource ledger retain one-tile execution on tiny/response/mixed/resource-rejected domains; explicit zero/one tile or zero-byte overrides retain the incumbent. Independent E/V and complete cold/warm/moved E/F gates qualify the policy without added per-build AO/jet/contraction work. Point algebra and ordered accumulation are unchanged.
entries.revisit_condition: Refine resource/profitability admission using additional devices and workloads, not device or molecule-size whitelists. Retain opt-out, constrained-memory fallback and ordered E/V semantics. The small cold population, differing cold trajectories, hardware-counter permissions and separate #2072 composition remain disclosed follow-up qualification, not claims of universal profitability.

entries.rationale: Unset selects resident final-state matrix products for strict-FP64 all-electron full-range restricted global hybrids with matching exact-direct or density-fitted J/K at 384 or more AOs and exact-direct or density-fitted pure-J KS at 544 or more AOs. Stationary-density energy confirmation repairs the ordinary strict exact-direct pure-J SCF tail without changing any convergence gate, replacing the temporary 1088-AO admission hold. Source-bound Direct/48/96 complete cold/warm/moved/moved-warm control/default comparisons retain independent scientific gates and semantic work. The repair and integrated-head cohorts retain their own native image identities and per-call work counts separately. The original 192 r2SCAN-3c calls and candidate plots remain historical and the +15.985% Direct/96 moved failure is still rejected. Positive Direct/48 benefits below the descriptive 2%/MAD label remain enabled; DF and the prior PBE0 384/768-AO evidence retain their separate scope. Bounded packets, matrix handle, accepted generation, published scratch-lease gates and explicit 0 fallback remain unchanged; explicit 1 remains experimental outside the default scope. A Standard incremental owner may reuse the same final products only after two consecutive full-density energies and the complete canonical proof; provisional delta operators remain excluded. The 2026-10-23 fitted-hybrid extension shares the same final matrix proof and retains explicit rollback, independent CPU/dense references and complete moved endpoint qualification.
entries.revisit_condition: Require source-bound complete cold/warm/moved/moved-warm endpoint nonregression and independent scientific acceptance for further changes; changed SCF work, a verifier repair or a warm-only gain cannot waive a slower complete endpoint. Keep the separate 384-AO hybrid and 544-AO pure-J lower bounds until smaller shapes are qualified for default admission. Preserve original source identities and negatives; do not infer other-functional timing gains. Separately qualify UKS, mixed exact/fitted J/K, RSH, nonlocal, unclosed incremental, ECP, lower precision and device-chunk stationary confirmation; retain the bounded fallback and unchanged true maximum-residual gate.

entries.rationale: Unset/empty selects relative-response order-six reuse and guarded pure-J density-first order-six/seven contraction for the existing strict-FP64 restricted exact-direct full-range domain with at least 384 AOs. The actual J/K source, resident final density, prefix/topology, ECP/DF/RSH/nonlocal exclusions and optional resources remain guarded. Independent D4/gCP geometry terms are allowed for pure J; hybrids with D4 remain excluded. Earlier spatial-reuse qualification remains historical; the relative/density promotion has separate source-matched 48/96-atom complete-endpoint, independent-oracle and actual-work evidence. Nonzero exchange, seeds, partial masks and unsafe reorderings keep component contraction. Explicit spatial-reuse/1 retains the previous control, relative-reuse omits density contraction, and 0/unknown values retain the incumbent; no selector bypasses scientific/resource guards.
entries.revisit_condition: Qualify further source/model variants using independent physical E+F and full cold/warm/moved timings before claiming broad performance wins. Preserve bounded fallbacks, negative results and method-independent operator safety; track the independent low-memory shell-lease fallback and publication of source-matched raw benchmark artifacts under #2416.

entries.rationale: Unset/empty/1/relative selects generated relative-coordinate FP64 AD for full-range weighted Direct force orders one through five. The shared fixed-weight scalar reuses pair-separation and Coulomb responses; ssss, FP32 and long-range roots remain unchanged. Every source reduction must be finite before atom scatter, otherwise the original nuclear FP64 graph retries once. Prepared HF/DFT owners capture the independent arithmetic selector; zero/unknown retains nuclear roots. Source-matched complete 48/96-atom, PBE0/HF, reverse-order and original-image comparisons independently qualify the default, preserving actual trajectories, scientific/resource guards and explicit small regressions.
entries.revisit_condition: Qualify new consumer/resource domains with independent finite E/F gates and full cold/warm/moved endpoints. Preserve bounded nuclear fallback and record actual SCF/Fock counts; do not infer endpoint gains from static DAG counts or relabel an incremental component as GPU4PySCF parity.

entries.rationale: Ordinary native KS requests compact mapped density/features and local Vxc contractions for bounded 32–1024-AO groups within the existing additional XC byte cap. Original point/AO maps and ordered FP64 accumulation remain unchanged. Large groups use unique global AO-row owners without floating-point atomics. The historical 96-atom PBE0 experiment improves cold/moved complete E+F; warm changes remain below the 2% noise floor, not an all-workload promotion pass. Unsupported groups, response, mixed precision, optional providers and constrained public ledgers retain bounded fallback. Explicit zero Ragged/compact controls restore small-domain admission or disable compact batching.
entries.revisit_condition: Refine the bounded scatter and residency domain with additional devices, methods and complete endpoints rather than molecule/device whitelists. Do not infer large-system or universal profitability from the small-domain positive population; retain zero opt-out, original selected work, numerical gates and resource fallback.

entries.rationale: Public CUDA DFT forces use one method-name-free and architecture-agnostic active-AO policy keyed by execution composition, spin, derivative order, provider/resource identity and a continuous dense-work cost proxy. Ordinary all-electron Direct RKS/UKS force execution with supported AO-jet orders 1/2 admits map discovery once predicted dense point×AO² work reaches the retained positive crossover; every capability/resource/profitability miss remains dense. CUDA architecture is recorded as workload provenance only and is not a selection predicate.
entries.revisit_condition: Refine the cost crossover with additional devices and workload shapes rather than adding architecture, molecule, atom-count, AO-count or grid-count windows. Broaden to composite execution, DF or ECP only with source/device-identified complete endpoint evidence; keep every unsupported or unprofitable case dense.

entries.rationale: Default-off canonical full J/K and range K joint traversal with one density projection and common high-order primitive geometry/Hermite preparation. Separate radial values and independent outputs remain; an optional two-spin Cartesian range matrix is charged after existing owners. No cross-AO cooperative source tile or derivative gain is claimed.
entries.revisit_condition: Actual executed candidate/radial counts and independent full/SR/LR matrices, both spins, screened/dense domains, budgets and alias gates; device sanitizers and same-binary complete cold/warm/displaced/larger endpoint evidence.

entries.rationale: Density fitting changes the finite numerical Hamiltonian through an auxiliary basis, Coulomb-metric factorization and threshold. The public default therefore remains direct/exact; selecting auto chooses a backend only after the caller has explicitly selected the density-fitted model.
entries.revisit_condition: Do not silently replace an exact/direct request with density fitting. Higher-level workflows may recommend or explicitly select DF only while preserving the auxiliary-basis and metric-threshold model identity.

entries.rationale: Seminumerical COSX changes the exchange approximation and carries an explicit quadrature/model-error identity. It is not an interchangeable execution provider for exact exchange and therefore must not be selected merely from a performance crossover.
entries.revisit_condition: Keep COSX explicit in the mathematical Fock request. Automatic provider selection may choose only among implementations of the already selected COSX model, never between exact exchange and COSX.

entries.rationale: HF/LDA preliminary SCF can reduce target iterations and has profitable measured domains, but it adds a second solve and can change the SCF trajectory/root. Existing evidence is intentionally domain-specific, so normal target execution must not silently insert it.
entries.revisit_condition: Promote only through an explicit source/model/workload guard with complete source+target endpoint benefit, unchanged final target-state gates, root/state comparison and deterministic cold fallback. Otherwise retain the explicit initial-guess request.

entries.rationale: Automatic MINAO remains the compatibility default for older libraries without native Huckel support, guarded to its original FP64 all-electron H-Ar restricted exact CPU HF/KS and CUDA KS domains. Existing densities take precedence, unsupported batches retain Hcore and explicit None rolls back. Current libraries prefer the separately registered native Huckel default.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit for root/state regressions, complete-endpoint regressions, or broader provider/domain qualification. Do not turn on HF/LDA preliminary solves, DF, UKS, ECP, mixed precision, or unsupported elements through this default.

entries.rationale: Native Modified Huckel is the user-authorized FP64 all-electron restricted H-Ar CPU/CUDA HF/KS default, including DF. Positive additive target-domain capability bits prevent old libraries from advertising unimplemented CUDA RHF/DF integrations. Exact atomic preparation does not change the target approximation. Budget limits, strict independent numerical gates, warm precedence and one ordinary Hcore retry remain mandatory. Measured benefits are workload-specific, not a universal speedup claim.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit on root/state or complete-endpoint regressions. Unsupported spin, ECP, elements, precision and resource-planner domains remain unchanged; preserve explicit None rollback and independent DF numerical validation.

entries.rationale: Cross-basis projection explicitly introduces a source calculation and transports an occupied subspace into the target metric. The target Hamiltonian is rebuilt, but the seed can alter the SCF basin and complete retained evidence does not show a universal workflow speedup.
entries.revisit_condition: Do not enable projection implicitly from a target Calculator. A declared progressive workflow may choose it only with an explicit source model, metric/rank validation, target-state verification and cold fallback.

entries.rationale: The common TensorIR proof safely retains immutable reference transforms within one conventional CPU solve, with unchanged dynamic amplitudes and independent replay. A corrected matched-budget CPU solve probe did not reproduce the initial noisy slower sign, but this bounded synthetic result does not establish representative molecular or GPU benefit. The schedule remains internal and default-off.
entries.revisit_condition: Require representative complete molecular endpoint benefit, full retained-memory accounting, unchanged physical replay and convergence, and real-device CUDA owner validation before promoting a backend. Do not infer an unmeasured shape threshold from the initial bounded probe.

entries.rationale: The internal option defaults to false, while native CUDA DF amplitude owners automatically enable incoming-residual weighted Anderson mixing for energies and the forward solve of complete analytic-force calls. History pairs outgoing damped Jacobi maps with incoming physical residuals using fixed validated shifted denominators. This changes the nonlinear trajectory and avoids separate trial equation evaluations; every observed state and independent expanded physical replay remain fresh. CPU, conventional, supplied-problem, Lambda/response equations and no-DIIS contracts remain unchanged. Independent complete-force gates and fresh scoped force ABBA endpoints extend the original energy qualification, without a universal convergence, statistical/global speedup or process-RSS claim.
entries.revisit_condition: Broaden the automatic consumer domain only after independent molecular and response gates plus complete endpoint evidence; revisit the fixed weighted-error rationale if preconditioning or damping changes within a solve, or if a qualified case shows unacceptable convergence behavior.

entries.rationale: Experimental opt-in uniform FP32 auxiliary warmup retains FP64 amplitudes, core, energy, ordered Q accumulation and DIIS arithmetic. A residual threshold or finite evaluation cap permanently restores the original FP64 graph, discards approximate history and preserves independent expanded physical replay. Only an internally generated warm-start state with originally admitted restricted-pair symmetry may recover the existing compiler-owned pair representation; externally asymmetric guesses are never repaired.
